## Run

    mise trust
    mise install
    mise run up

The API opens on http://localhost:10100. Host ports 10100-10199, bound to `127.0.0.1`.
Defaults are local-only placeholders; overrides go in `.deploy/local/.env` (optional, keys as in `.deploy/local/.example.env`).
Without mise: `docker compose -f .deploy/local/docker-compose.yml --profile app up -d --build`.
Stop with `mise run down` (volumes kept). `.deploy/local/README.md` lists every port and service.
One browser profile is signed in to one project at a time on `localhost`: cookies are per host, not per port.

## Edit a component on the host

Stop its container, then run it on the host on the same port (`mise run infra` starts the infrastructure alone):

    docker compose -f .deploy/local/docker-compose.yml stop acme-backend-srv
    mise run dev:srv

## TCK

Tags: @core, @identity, @otel, @parameters, @tenancy

Add `FIXTURE_ADMIN=admin@example.com`, `FIXTURE_TENANT_SLUG=acme` to `.deploy/local/.env` (acme-backend-srv reads it in both modes), then run `mise run up` again or restart `mise run dev:srv`. Once per clone: `npm --prefix specs ci`. Then:

    mise run tck
